stories.title: El PP vuelve a citar a Marlaska, Robles y Albares en el Senado

en.title: The PP summons Marlaska, Robles and Albares to the Senate again
en.summary: The opposition People's Party, which holds a majority in the upper chamber, is intensifying pressure on three government ministers after they declined to appear for hearings in August.

stories.title: Pedro Ruiz, contundente sobre los conciertos de Shakira en Madrid: «Me cuesta mucho entenderlo»

en.title: Pedro Ruiz, blunt about Shakira's Madrid concerts: "It's hard for me to understand it"
en.summary: Shakira is performing 12 concerts in Madrid as part of her tour, with over 684,000 attendees expected through October. A themed park called Macondo Park has been created at the venue to enhance the experience.

stories.title: Otegi confirma su apoyo "táctico" a un nuevo estatuto vasco con el PNV y el PSE para "seguir avanzando" hacia el soberanismo

en.title: Otegi confirms his "tactical" support for a new Basque statute with the PNV and PSE to "continue advancing" toward sovereignty
en.summary: The nationalist leader Bildu is backing a statute agreement between three parties as part of his strategy to counter far-right politics and advance sovereignty goals.

stories.title: La UPV inaugura el curso en Hangzhou del Beihang Valencia Polytechnic Institute (BVPI)

en.title: The UPV opens the Hangzhou course at the Beihang Valencia Polytechnic Institute (BVPI)
en.summary: The University of Valencia has inaugurated its first campus in China recognized by the education ministry, currently enrolling nearly 400 students.

stories.title: Veinticinco guardias civiles para 1.700 inmigrantes: «Cada día diez marroquíes intentan colarse en barcos hacia la Península»

en.title: Twenty-five Civil Guards for 1,700 immigrants: "Every day ten Moroccans try to sneak onto boats heading to the Peninsula"
en.summary: Twenty-five Civil Guard officers are assigned to secure a camp in Ceuta's port housing immigrants who entered during late July incidents. Guards report no planned reinforcements and worry detainees will attempt to flee to mainland Spain hidden in departing vessels.

stories.title: Interior refuerza la seguridad en Melilla ante la fuerte amenaza de una invasión como la de Ceuta

en.title: Interior strengthens security in Melilla amid strong threat of invasion like Ceuta's
en.summary: Spain's Interior Ministry has deployed additional Civil Guard reserve officers to Melilla following social media calls for a mass crossing similar to the Ceuta incident. Security officials consider current troop levels insufficient against potential large-scale attempted entries.

stories.title: Trump anuncia un acuerdo con Dinamarca para asumir el “control permanente de la seguridad” de Groenlandia

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Denmark to assume "permanent control of security" in Greenland
en.summary: Trump announced a security agreement regarding Greenland that Denmark's Prime Minister Frederiksen confirmed, describing it as shared Arctic security. The accord involves preventing hostile nations from establishing bases.

stories.title: Trump logra que Dinamarca otorgue a EEUU el "control permanente" de la seguridad de Groenlandia: "Ningún adversario podrá tener una base"

en.title: Trump achieves Denmark granting US "permanent control" of Greenland security: "No adversary will be able to have a base"
en.summary: Trump secured an agreement with Denmark regarding permanent U.S. security control over Greenland. Greenland stated the accord preserves its territorial integrity and sovereignty.

stories.title: Trump logra el control militar de Groenlandia sin comprar la isla

en.title: Trump gains military control of Greenland without buying the island
en.summary: Trump announced an agreement with Denmark and Greenland giving the United States permanent control over the Arctic island's security and authorization over any foreign military presence there, along with plans for significant U.S. troop deployment.

stories.title: Estados Unidos y Dinamarca llegan a un acuerdo sobre Groenlandia tras la amenaza de anexión de Trump

en.title: United States and Denmark reach agreement on Greenland following Trump's annexation threat
en.summary: The U.S. president announced plans to immediately begin developing a significant military presence in Greenland following negotiations with Denmark.

stories.title: Más loba, más empoderada: Shakira arrasa Madrid a golpe de cadera y de nostalgia en su regreso a España

en.title: More fierce, more empowered: Shakira overwhelms Madrid with hip movements and nostalgia upon her return to Spain
en.summary: Shakira performed in Madrid after an eight-year absence from Spain. Despite an uneven start, her hits and dancing ultimately captivated the audience.

stories.title: Shakira, al público español en su regreso a Madrid: “Con la cara que me fui de España y con la que vuelvo”

en.title: Shakira, to Spanish audience on her return to Madrid: "With the face I left Spain and with the one I return"
en.summary: Colombian singer Shakira inaugurated her 12-concert residency in Madrid, emphasizing resilience and stating that the key to happiness comes from within oneself.

stories.title: Los 'hackers' usan IA de Anthropic para entrar en OpenAI

en.title: Hackers use Anthropic's AI to access OpenAI
en.summary: A security firm discovered that attackers exploited artificial intelligence tools from Anthropic to gain unauthorized access to internal systems of ChatGPT's parent company.

stories.title: La IA no vuelve al cole este curso en la Gran Manzana

en.title: AI does not return to school this academic year in the Big Apple
en.summary: New York City's mayor has banned artificial intelligence use in primary school classrooms for the 2026-2027 school year, while secondary students will receive instruction on AI risks and biases.

stories.title: Rosewood Luang Prabang, refugio de aventureros

en.title: Rosewood Luang Prabang, refuge for adventurers
en.summary: The Rosewood Luang Prabang hotel offers guests an experience beyond typical accommodation, presenting itself as a state of mind and a way of engaging with the world's history.

stories.title: El retraso en la ley 'cripto' de EEUU frena el despegue del sector

en.title: Delay in US crypto law hampers sector growth
en.summary: The U.S. Senate rejected approval of the Clarity Act, comprehensive cryptocurrency legislation awaited by investors, with potential conflicts of interest involving Trump and his family's crypto-related businesses cited as a major obstacle.

stories.title: Gadgets para grabar conversaciones y llamadas con IA

en.title: Gadgets for recording conversations and calls with AI
en.summary: Devices capable of recording and transcribing conversations and calls using artificial intelligence technology are now available.
